[source = RecordIdentity!val!0,
 source_eligible = [else -> True],

scope: Uninterpreted record identities and relationship relations; eligible/disclosable projection invariance for existential original-key traversal. Arbitrary nonnegative integer cardinalities demonstrate raw truncation leakage.
limitations: Eligibility, original identity/key correspondence and relationship disclosure are assumed; no new policy permission is granted.
Private witness is modeled only as existence, not as a complete policy decision.
No path/multiplicity/outer-join/order/cardinality reconstruction theorem or backend case promotion.
